title: Critical temperatures of superconductors, 1911 to 2019
description: Bar chart. The temperature below which each material superconducts, in kelvin: mercury (1911) 4.2; lead (1913) 7; niobium nitride (1941) 16; La–Ba–Cu–O (1986) 35; Y–Ba–Cu–O (1987) 93; Hg–Ba–Ca–Cu–O (1993) 133; lanthanum hydride under high pressure (2019) 250. The cuprates of 1987 and 1993 are above 77 K, where liquid nitrogen boils. Data: Wikipedia, Superconductivity, High-temperature superconductivity and Cuprate superconductor.
heading: CRITICAL TEMPERATURE · KELVIN · 77 K = LIQUID NITROGEN
